en: You may be right.

Well, I never would have fallen for senpai if he was the
kind of guy who'd abandon me to some random thugs.
I saw right through him.

I knew something was up, so I pretended
to run off and hid nearby to watch.
After all, idols have to be good at acting, right?

I'm so happy, though. I had no idea he was
so invested in making sure I achieved my dreams.

I... I won't let him down.
I'm going to give this all I've got.

Good. I'm sure your senpai will be happy to hear that.
He should be able to keep his distance in peace.
Idols aren't allowed to be in love, remember?

Um... do you think he'll still be waiting for me
when I'm done with everything I want to do?
Him? He'd wait even if you told him not to.
Well, good luck, Misa. I'll be rooting for you.
Becoming an idol's only the first part of my dream.

To be honest, there's one more thing I want
to do in the entertainment industry.

I want to perform in a crowded dome full of
loving fans. That's where I'll announce my retirement.

Everyone in the audience and watching on TV will be
so surprised. I'll run off the stage, and be gone forever.
Just like Haruka-chan.
I hope you're joking.

So, what do you think? You have firsthand
experience with that, right, Kiryu-san?
Don't do it.

It'll be nothing but trouble for those around you.
The media seriously never lets up...
It's a harsh world out there, huh?
I'll have to do my best.
Um... Kiryu-san, right?
Hm? Oh, you're the guy Misa is in love with.

Yeah. I want to thank you
for everything you did for her.
Have you spoken to her since then?

I haven't. She already knows how I feel,
and I already know how she feels about me.

Someday soon she'll be on TV and in magazines.
I can't wait to see what she makes of herself.

Though... even though I'm trying to act cool,
I can't help but wonder if I made the right decision.

I wouldn't have time to worry if I was still
with the team, but I already retired.
Uh-huh. What kind of team were you on?

Baseball. The team wasn't the greatest around,
but I was the captain for a few years.

Oh? I'm actually on a baseball team myself.
It's just a little local one, though.

If you'd like, maybe you could come play
on our team between classes sometime.

It'll help you stop worrying so much. Besides,
anyone with experience is welcome on our team.

Thank you so much! In that case,
I might just take you up on that offer.

My name is Kase. I can't wait to
start playing games together, Kiryu-san.
Same to you, Kase-senpai.
Mie-san, you can't let them trick you like this!
Y'got it all wrong.

Jus' don't worry about it.
I'll be fine, really.

That's what they want you to think, Mie-san!
Trust me, those Munan Chohept Onast guys are bad news!

Munan Chohept?
What are they talking about?

Everyone over there's jus' so nice, though!
You'll see if ya come down to the facility.
You'd make a great Friend, y'know.
They're gonna bleed you dry, Mie-san!

They've told you about the donations, right?
How that's the only way to salvation?

It's called titherance! We've gotta
show our devotion to the divine savior.
I don't care <font_kind=yakuza_italic>what</font_kind> it's called!
Listen to me. You can't keep going back there!
Hands off, old man.
E-Excuse me?
S-Sorry, I lost my temper for a second.
That's enough.

Y'wouldn't get mad so easily
if you jus' had a little faith.
Wait, Mie-san!

You came on a little strong there.
I assume you have your reasons?
Um, who are you?

I'm just passing by. I'm actually not
from around here. The name's Kiryu.

Um, if it's all right with you, d-do you think
you can hear me out? I can't promise it'll be quick.
Sorry, I'm busy.

Sure, I'll listen.
You look pretty drained, old man.
Munan Chohept Onast is to blame for that.
What exactly is this Munan thing anyway?

They're a terrible cult that's been
around for over 30 years now.

Lately they've left the big cities
for small towns like this.

Elderly retirees with no relatives
are their primary targets.
Naturally, they're only after their money.

Which brings us to the woman from earlier.
She's wrapped up with this cult now, huh?
Yeah. Her name is Mie-san.

I only just moved here a couple of months ago,
but she's shown me nothing but kindness.

Talking to Mie-san takes me back to when
I was still chasin' skirts around town...

But she's changed.
I can't believe she'd fall for their lies!
And you're absolutely sure this religion is a scam?
There's no doubt in my mind, yeah.

This cult transforms its followers into thoughtless drones.
They make them donate every last yen they have, too.
That's terrible.

As for Mie-san, her husband died recently
after many great years in her care.

And those bastards took advantage
of her at her most vulnerable.
She won't listen to a word I say, though.

Others from around town have joined the cult as well.
They all think it's the most wonderful thing in the world.

At the very least, I want to save Mie-san.
I can't bear to watch her throw her life away like this.
Have you gone to the police?
They wouldn't listen to me, either.

The cops won't lift a finger until
they can have some hard evidence.
But it'll be too late by then!

Um, I hesitate to ask this of you...
We only just met, after all.

Please, will you come over to the
Munan Chohept Onast facility with me?

We should be able to sneak in
if we pretend we want to join.

I'd never be able to do it alone at my age. 
But... I can't just abandon Mie-san!
I'll drag her out kicking and screaming if I have to.

Sorry, I'm a little busy right now.
Maybe some other time.

Yeah, let's do it. I won't let you rush in there
alone and risk getting yourself hurt.
Thank you, Kiryu-san!
So, where is their headquarters?
It's down by the coast.
It's over by the train tracks.

There should be some young ladies passing out
flyers out front. You'll know when you see it.
All right. Shall we?

Yeah. We should head over separately, though.
They're more likely to take us in if we're alone.
Does that sound good?

Yeah, I know how they operate.
Lonely-looking people are easy prey for them.

Anyway, I'll head over first to look for Mie-san.
I'll see you there soon, Kiryu-san.
Right, see you.

Oh, Kiryu-san! Do you have time
to listen to my story right now?

Oh, Kiryu-san. Will you accompany me
to the Munan Chohept headquarters?

Embrace the salvation of this
heavenly body we call Earth!
The light of the world shall permeate your soul!

(Those girls are handing out flyers...
This must be that cult's headquarters.)
Excuse me, ladies.

What is it? Is there anything
we can assist you with today?

(If I'm going to rescue Mie-san, I need to
act like I want into this cult. Let's do this!)

Yes. I'm, uh...
A stray sheep looking for guidance.
Yes, that much is clear.

Such is the burden of this mortal coil.
You are not alone in that feeling.

I heard you guys might be able to help me.
So, I...
I want to join the Order of Saren Chohabt Atrast.

Saren Chohabt Atrast?
That order is in another town down south.
My apologies, but we have nothing to offer you.

(I really botched that.
But how the hell is that a real name...?)
May your journey ahead be blessed.
(Now what was the name of this cult...?)
I want to join the Order of Aban Chodesht Orest.

Aban Chodesht Orest?
That order is in another town up to the north.
My apologies, but we can offer no help to you here.

(I really botched that.
But seriously? That's a real name?)
I want to join the Order of Munan Chohept Onast.

Ah! So the tenets of Munan Chohept Onast run deep
within your veins as well? How wonderful!

Glory be!
You have arrived in the light!

Yeah, it was a long road. I endured a lot
of hardship, but I'm glad I'm finally here.

Just relax, you poor thing. Our door
is always open. Now, come right this way!
Sorry to interrupt you again.

What is it?
Do you have further business with us?

My search for salvation has gone astray.
I was knocking on all the wrong doors.
Which means what?
Well, I...
I want to join the Order of Mosan Chohip Istes.

That's not the same name you said earlier, you know.
Either way, you clearly lack devotion to our order.
It seems I cannot help you.

Wait, hold on a sec. I'm just tripping over my words a bit.
I remember now. I...
I want to join the Order of Miran Choakht Onest.

I see. So you truly seek to become
a disciple of Munan Chohept Onast?
Yeah. I think I've finally seen the light.

What wonderful news! Very well then!
Please, come right this way.
(That went smoother than expected.)
Come. Right this way.

There just so happens to have been another lost
Friend who arrived on our doorstep today.
It's nice to meet you, Brother.

(The old man...
I guess he didn't have any trouble getting in.)

This gentleman listened quite ardently to my explanation
of our tenets. He is truly an ideal member already.
Right, Brother Suzuki-san?

I'm not worthy of such praise yet, Sister.
But hept-onast for the compliment.

Um, it sounded like you
just said "hept-onast."

Hept-onast is one of our order's holy words.
It is similar in meaning to the phrase "thank you."

Come, now. She just taught you something.
Show a little gratitude.
Hept-onast very much, Sister.

I can show our new Friend
here around if you'd like.

It must be a sign that we turned to the
light of Munan Chohept Onast on the same day.

What a blessed idea.
Please do so.

I will be in the other room joining
our new Friends in the art of shooreh pippi.
Shooreh pippi?

Another one of their words, Kiryu-san.
It basically means training.
So they're training over in that other room?
Yeah. I'm sure Mie-san will be with them.
What the?
So this... is shooreh pippi?

Yes. It allows them to focus their spirits
and accumulate kulipaas.
Kulipaas?

In layman's terms, it can be considered a measure
of virtue. Accumulating kulipaas is vital.

Only by doing so can a Friend grow closer
to the divine being Munan Chohept.
Hept-onast for the explanation, Brother.
You're such a quick learner, Brother Suzuki-san.

Are you sure today is your first Munan Chohept Onast
experience? It's astounding to believe.

You may not even need
to undergo chomo gomes.
What's chomo gomes?

Isn't it obvious, Kiryu-san?
It's a word that essentially means brainwashing.

They insist it's simply re-education,
but there's no doubt what it really is.

Do you know what happens when a disciple
in the Order of Munan Chohept shows signs of doubt?

They lock them away and force them
to undergo chomo gomes.

This cult is even crazier than I thought.
They're insane.

But he's right, you haven't had any
problems blending right in here.

You know all their lingo like the back of your hand.
For a new "friend," you're pretty familiar.
...Almost <font_kind=yakuza_italic>too</font_kind> familiar.

Oh, well, uh... That shows how desperate I am
to save Mie-san. I must become one of them.

Anyway, we should join in
on the shooreh pippi as well.

Wait, what?
We have to do it, too?

We'll stick out like a sore thumb if we don't.
Come on, hurry!
Dammit. This is ridiculous...

So, old man.
Have you found Mie-san?

She said she was planning on making a huge donation
to the guru. She's probably purifying in preparation.
Do we know if she's even in this building...?

I'm not entirely sure where she is,
but we should keep pretending for now.

No matter what, we need to stop her
from giving them that donation!
Ahem! My disciples, please give me your attention!

To reward you for undying devotion to shooreh pippi,
the guru has decided to grace us with his presence.
Oooh!
Our spiritual leader, Munan Akamatsu, has arrived!
The guru...!
This clown is their guru?

That title has been passed down through the years.
Apparently Akamatsu only took the helm recently.
My disciples...
Munancho!

Kiryu-san, say it back!
That's how they greet each other.

Very nicely done.
Two spirit points for you.
(Am I getting graded now?)
Minus one spirit point.
(This is absurd.)
Minus three spirit points.

Good! Glory be. Our divine savior
Munan Chohept is most pleased.

As you are all well aware, the best way to amplify
the power of your shooreh pippi is through titherance.
Only then can you accumulate maximum kulipaas.

Take our new friend Sister Mie-san for example.
She will be offering 100 rinchos today.
Huh? 100 rinchos!?
Mie-san sets an example for you all, my disciples.
Mie-san is truly a blessed Friend!

What immense faith! Your Holiness,
I too will offer up 100 rinchos of my own tomorrow!
